basis: Ser/Thr kinase; infected cells by Molecular Cartography (infected vs uninfected, t-test) and 97% of F/G nuclei vs <=14% outside the infected lineage (Cervantes-Perez et al. 2024 Plant Commun). Not in the Zhang 2025 filtered pseudobulk, so no second-study check. Third study: Liu 2023 Nat Plants IC cluster 12 86% vs 11% (Supp. Data 3); raised medium->high (2026-10-20).

Nodulin-26 aquaglyceroporin targeted to the peribacteroid (symbiosome) membrane of infected cells (Fortin et al. 1985 EMBO J; 1987 NAR). In nuclei it is 93-97% in F/G/H but 26-49% in every other cluster (Cervantes-Perez 2024): use enrichment, not presence. Liu 2023 IC cluster 12 93% vs 18% (Supp. Data 3) agrees.

Leghemoglobin a: O2 carrier in infected-cell cytoplasm needed for N fixation (Ott et al. 2005 Curr Biol, Lotus). Marks the N-fixing state (cluster H 96%) but only 16-17% of F/G, and 43-70% of nuclei of all other clusters (ambient, Cervantes-Perez 2024): never use as a negative marker.
Leghemoglobin c1; as Lba: N-fixing infected cells (H 97%), F/G 12-13%, ambient 27-56% elsewhere (Cervantes-Perez 2024; Ott et al. 2005 Curr Biol).
Leghemoglobin c2; N-fixing infected cells (H 96%), ambient 18-43% elsewhere (Cervantes-Perez 2024); weakly higher in Zhang 2025 15-dpi infected pseudobulk (40 vs <=23 CPM).

PI-PLC X-domain ortholog of MtDNF2 (Table S7), which keeps bacteroids alive and suppresses defense in infected cells (Bourcy et al. 2013 New Phytol); F 74%, G 91% vs <=2% (Cervantes-Perez 2024). Ortholog-level function, no soybean reporter. Third study: Liu 2023 IC cluster 12 60% vs 3% (Supp. Data 3); raised medium->high.

Ortholog of LjFEN1 homocitrate synthase that supplies nitrogenase cofactor in infected cells (Hakoyama et al. 2009 Nature; ortholog from Table S7; UniProt names it 2-isopropylmalate synthase family). G 77% but F 9%: marks one infected sub-state (Cervantes-Perez 2024). Third study: Liu 2023 IC cluster 12 58% vs 3% (Supp. Data 3); raised medium->high.

TIR-NBS-LRR host-range gene (Yang et al. 2010 PNAS); F/G 28-30% vs <=0.3% (Cervantes-Perez 2024) and a de novo infected-cell marker in Zhang 2025 (14% vs 1%; 116 vs <=14 CPM; not used to label). Two independent atlases, single-cell evidence only. Third study: Liu 2023 IC cluster 12 17% vs 0.3% (Supp. Data 3); raised medium->high.

Symbiotic remorin; MtSYMREM1 is needed for infection and bacterial release (Lefebvre et al. 2010 PNAS). Infected-cell marker in Liu et al. 2023 Nat Plants (ID via Zhang 2025 Table S2); F/G 62-79%, H 47% vs <=5% (Cervantes-Perez 2024); Zhang 2025 infected 147 vs <=28 CPM. Liu 2023 own table now read: IC cluster 12 66% vs 3% (Supp. Data 3), so Liu counts as an independent study (before, only via Zhang citation); raised medium->high.

NT-C2 protein; MtRPG directs infection-thread polar growth (Arrighi et al. 2008 PNAS, ortholog-level function). Three independent atlases: Liu 2023 Nat Plants transitional IC subcluster 12-1 79% vs <=1% (Supp. Data 8), Cervantes-Perez 2024 F/G 22-26% vs <=5%, Zhang 2025 infected 45% vs 4%. Raised medium->high (evidence characterized_enriched->function) on 2026-10-20. Highest in the 12-dpi infection state, lower in mature fixing cells.

CYCLOPS/IPD3 transcription factor of the common symbiosis pathway; IPD3 is needed for symbiosome formation (Ovchinnikova et al. 2011 MPMI; Horvath et al. 2011 MPMI). F/G 44-49% vs <=4% (Cervantes-Perez 2024); Zhang 2025 de novo infected marker (29% vs 3%; not used to label). Also active in root hairs and AM symbiosis. Third study: Liu 2023 IC cluster 12 32% vs 3% (Supp. Data 3); raised medium->high.

Rab-GAP TBC-domain protein (uncharacterized); F/G 91-93% vs <=3% (Cervantes-Perez 2024) and Zhang 2025 de novo infected marker (44% vs 7%). Specific to the infected lineage in two independent atlases. Third study: Liu 2023 IC cluster 12 84% vs 7% (Supp. Data 3); raised medium->high (expression-only gene, three atlases).

TIR-domain protein (uncharacterized); F/G 76-80% vs <=7% (Cervantes-Perez 2024) and Zhang 2025 de novo infected marker (19% vs 2%). Third study: Liu 2023 IC cluster 12 59% vs 6% (Supp. Data 3); raised medium->high (expression-only gene, three atlases).

Uncharacterized protein; F/G 39-44% vs 0% (Cervantes-Perez 2024) and Zhang 2025 de novo infected marker (46% vs 4%). Third study: Liu 2023 IC cluster 12 29% vs 0.7% (Supp. Data 3); raised medium->high (expression-only gene, three atlases).

CBS-domain (CNNM/DUF21) protein; MtCBS1 is required for rhizobial infection (Sinharoy et al. 2016 Plant Physiol). Liu 2023 Nat Plants transitional IC subcluster 12-1 84% vs 0.4% (Supp. Data 8) and Zhang 2025 (15 dpi) 54% vs 9%, but 0% in every Cervantes-Perez 2024 28-dpi cluster: young-nodule infection state only. Raised low->medium (Liu own table) on 2026-10-20.

Trehalose-6-P synthase; infected cells by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024; Methods misprint 15G2100100), F/G 23-27%. Conflict: Zhang 2025 finds it in the nodule phloem cluster (26% vs 4%; 705 vs <=64 CPM).
L-ascorbate peroxidase; infected cells by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024) but detected in only 14% of F/G nuclei, and not enriched in Zhang 2025 infected cells.

RNA in situ in the central infected zone at 12 and 21 dpi (Liu et al. 2023 Nat Plants Fig. 3c); 36% of IC cluster 12 vs 0.9% elsewhere; Cervantes-Perez 2024 infection zone F/G 63-68% vs 0% elsewhere. Two-study agreement.
RNA in situ in central zone (Liu et al. 2023 Nat Plants Fig. 3c); IC cluster 12 20% vs 0.8%; Cervantes-Perez 2024 F/G 48/30% vs <=6%.
Liu IC cluster 12 62% vs 1.5%; Cervantes-Perez 2024 F/G 76/82%.
Liu IC cluster 12 36% vs 0.9% and Stereo-seq infected-zone gene; Cervantes-Perez 2024 F/G 50/51%.

Early nodulin-55, phytocyanin family (Blank et al. GmENOD55); used as Liu IC marker; Zhang 2025 nodule infected-cell DE (26% vs 3%). Liu Supp. Data 5 lists GLYMA_13G024700 for ENOD55, which UniProt names a pyruvate carboxyltransferase: a table error; the notebook uses 02G204500.

Vapyrin needed for intracellular rhizobial progression (Murray et al. 2011 Plant J, Medicago); RNA in situ in 12-dpi central zone, absent at 21 dpi (Liu et al. 2023 Fig. 3c); 12-1 34% vs <=1%. Early infection-state marker; Cervantes-Perez 2024 (28 dpi) <=2%. [Liu transitional IC subcluster 12-1, 12 dpi; named Infection_Thread_Cell as in lotus_nodule]

RNA in situ in 12-dpi central zone only (Liu et al. 2023 Fig. 3c); 12-1 68% vs 0.06%; ~0 in Cervantes-Perez 2024 (28 dpi). [Liu transitional IC subcluster 12-1, 12 dpi; named Infection_Thread_Cell as in lotus_nodule]

NNL1 controls symbiotic compatibility via root-hair infection in soybean (Zhang et al. 2021 Nat Plants); Liu 12-1 53% vs <=1%; Zhang 2025 nodule infected cell 15% vs 1%. [Liu transitional IC subcluster 12-1, 12 dpi; named Infection_Thread_Cell as in lotus_nodule]

Nodulation pectate lyase required for infection-thread formation (Xie et al. 2012 PNAS, Lotus); Liu 12-1 21% vs 0%; Zhang 2025 infected cell 22% vs 3%. [Liu transitional IC subcluster 12-1, 12 dpi; named Infection_Thread_Cell as in lotus_nodule]

SPIKE1 guides polar growth of infection threads (Liu et al. 2020 Plant Cell, Lotus); Liu 12-1 37% vs 0%; Cervantes-Perez 2024 F 8%. [Liu transitional IC subcluster 12-1, 12 dpi; named Infection_Thread_Cell as in lotus_nodule]

Atypical receptor kinase required for rhizobial infection (Li et al. 2019 Plant Physiol, Lotus); Liu 12-1 24% vs <=1%. [Liu transitional IC subcluster 12-1, 12 dpi; named Infection_Thread_Cell as in lotus_nodule]

miR156b-GmSPL9d module regulates nodulation (Yun et al. 2022 New Phytol, soybean); Liu 12-1 29% vs <=1%; only 38 nuclei, single study. [Liu transitional IC subcluster 12-1, 12 dpi; named Infection_Thread_Cell as in lotus_nodule]

CRISPR knockout in hairy roots: more but white (Lb-poor) nodules (Liu et al. 2023 Nat Plants Fig. 3h); 12-1-specific (21% vs 0.2%); 0 in Cervantes-Perez 2024. [Liu transitional IC subcluster 12-1, 12 dpi; named Infection_Thread_Cell as in lotus_nodule]

Uricase II (nodulin-35 family; Ensembl: uricase-2 isozyme 1) of uninfected-cell peroxisomes, ureide synthesis (Nguyen et al. 1985 PNAS). J 61%, K 71% but also H 72%, I 44% (Cervantes-Perez 2024): weak against N-fixing infected nuclei. Unanchored Wm82.a2 scaffold ID; not found in Zhang 2025 (a4) tables.

Inducible nitrate reductase 2; uninfected-cell marker in Liu 2023 (via Zhang 2025 Table S2); K 51%, J 28% vs <=6% (Cervantes-Perez 2024); Zhang 2025 15-dpi uninfected 506 vs <=174 CPM. Liu 2023 own table: UC cluster 0 66% vs 21%, cluster 7 78% vs 26% (Supp. Data 3): weak enrichment, so not raised.

Ureide permease (UniProt/NCBI LOC100801814: probable ureide permease A3; Liu 2023 calls it GmUPS2-2). Liu 2023 Nat Plants UC cluster 0 70% vs 20% (Supp. Data 3) and Cervantes-Perez 2024 J 35%, K 27% vs <=12%; weak in Zhang 2025 (50 vs <=31 CPM). Conflict, not raised: the characterized-marker survey maps this ID (XP_003518768) to GmUPS1-2, localized to nodule cortex and vascular endodermis (Collier and Tegeder 2012 Plant J); the earlier note that GmUPS1 is a different paralog was wrong for this ID.

Tyrosine aminotransferase; uninfected cells by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024), K 36% vs <=8%. Caution: also a root cortex marker in the same paper and Zhang 2025 root/hypocotyl cortex; not enriched in Zhang 15-dpi uninfected cells. Require absence of cortex markers. Liu 2023 21-dpi UC cluster 11 65% vs 6% (Supp. Data 3): MC + cluster-specific in a second study, raised medium->high; the cortex caution still applies.
MLO-like protein; uninfected cells by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024) but only 9-12% of J/K nuclei; not specific in Zhang 2025.
Aspartate aminotransferase (N assimilation into Asp/Asn); Liu UC clusters 0/7/11 63-92%, but IC 36% and cortex <=38%; Cervantes-Perez 2024 UC J/K 33/60% vs <=3% elsewhere.

Uricase, ureide synthesis in peroxisomes of uninfected cells of soybean nodules (nodulin-35/uricase II localized to peroxisomes of uninfected cells, Nguyen et al. 1985 PNAS); Liu UC 0/7/11 56-66%, but vascular 39%, IC 22%; Cervantes-Perez 2024 <=5% everywhere (draft uses paralog Glyma.U032500 instead).

Beta-amylase (starch breakdown; UCs store starch); Liu UC cluster 11 48% vs 2%; Cervantes-Perez 2024 UC cluster K 38%, J 13%, <=4% elsewhere. Marks a 21-dpi UC state, not a separate type. [Liu 21-dpi UC cluster 11; kept as an Uninfected_Cell type row]
Beta-amylase; Liu UC cluster 11 51% vs <=5%; Cervantes-Perez 2024 K 4%. [Liu 21-dpi UC cluster 11; kept as an Uninfected_Cell type row]

Early nodulin-75 (NCBI LOC100791125 designation in Liu Supp. Data 3; UniProt A0A0R0EQ45 uncharacterized), the cell-wall HRGP family whose soybean in situ marks nodule parenchyma (inner cortex) (van de Wiel et al. 1990 EMBO J; proposed O2-barrier role, not shown). Top gene of Liu 2023 Nat Plants inner-cortex cluster 1 (23% vs 3%) and Stereo-seq inner-cortex region; Cervantes-Perez 2024 <=8% except cluster I 22%. The characterized survey row GmENOD2B is a different locus (Glyma.08G131925, Wm82.a4), and the 1990 probe may detect several paralogs, so this ID is not independently localized. Evidence lowered from the review's function to characterized_enriched.

Carbonic anhydrase (CO2/HCO3- for PEPC carbon supply; Kavroulakis et al. 2000 MPMI); Liu cluster 1 (37% vs 7%) and Stereo-seq inner-cortex gene; Cervantes-Perez 2024 cortex B 36% and vascular endodermis/'nodule parenchyma' C 36%, ~0 in infected zone. Cross-study agreement; bin-level Stereo-seq is not cell-resolution.

PEBP-like protein; RNA in situ (antisense vs sense) in nodule inner cortex (Liu et al. 2023 Nat Plants ED Fig. 6), but signal faint and only a few dozen nuclei express it; DE only at 12 dpi; 0% in all Cervantes-Perez 2024 clusters.
Cellulose synthase-like H1; Liu cluster 1 (28% vs 4%); Cervantes-Perez 2024 cortex B 32%.
TIR-domain protein; nodule inner/outer cortex by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024); A 42%, B 29%, but C 25%. Not cortex-specific in Zhang 2025 (15-dpi nodule with root).
ADP-ribosyl cyclase / TIR-like protein (uncharacterized); nodule cortex by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024), A 30%, B 10%. Also a root-hair marker in the same paper.
Uncharacterized; nodule cortex by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024) but broad: A 58%, B 43%, C 40%, J 31%.

PIN-LIKES 3 auxin carrier; nodule cortex by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024); A 17% vs <=1%. Highest in Zhang 2025 Cortex_Epidermis (355 vs <=225 CPM; label used this gene). Liu 2023 outer-cortex cluster 4 45% vs 15% (Supp. Data 3; label from Stereo-seq deconvolution); raised low->medium.
Receptor-like Ser/Thr kinase; nodule cortex by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024); A 13% vs <=1%.

Glyceollin-pathway P450; nodule cortex by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024), A 15%; also a root epidermis marker, and highest in Zhang 2025 uninfected cells. Possibly outer cortex/epidermis defense layer.
Glycinol 4-dimethylallyltransferase (glyceollin); nodule cortex by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024) but 5-6% of A/B nuclei; hypocotyl trichome marker in Zhang 2025.
Triterpenoid/saponin P450; Liu outer-cortex cluster 4 (31% vs 2%) and Stereo-seq outer-cortex region (Liu et al. 2023 Nat Plants). Not in Cervantes-Perez 2024 cortex clusters >=15%.
Liu cluster 2 (44% vs 10%) and Stereo-seq outer cortex; Cervantes-Perez 2024 A 28% but also I 53% (stress cluster): weak.

Uncharacterized; RNA in situ in nodule outermost layers (Liu et al. 2023 Nat Plants ED Fig. 6); specific to Liu cluster 5 (21% vs 1%), but cluster 5 is 55% root epidermis nuclei; absent from Cervantes-Perez 2024 (no epidermis cluster).

Ser/Thr kinase; nodule vascular endodermis by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024; C 23% vs <=2%) and an independent de novo endodermis marker of Zhang 2025 hypocotyl (54% vs 1%); also root endodermis in both papers. Liu 2023 unlabeled cluster 8 41% vs 2% (Supp. Data 3; cluster 8 was "Endodermis" in a draft notebook cell).

C2H2 zinc finger; vascular endodermis by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024; Methods misprint 14G227200) but only 6% of C nuclei; independent de novo root endodermis marker in Zhang 2025 (18% vs 1%) and 269 vs <=11 CPM in Zhang nodule endodermis. Liu 2023 unlabeled cluster 8 36% vs 2% (Supp. Data 3).

Class III peroxidase; vascular endodermis by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024; Methods misprint 04G218700; Table S8 calls it nodule parenchyma), C 11% vs <=2%. Zhang 2025 nodule endodermis 221 vs <=45 CPM (label based on other genes).

ENTH-domain protein (uncharacterized); C 47% vs <=1% (Cervantes-Perez 2024) and Zhang 2025 nodule endodermis de novo (14% vs 1%). Liu 2023 unlabeled cluster 8 43% vs 1% (Supp. Data 3); not raised because Liu left cluster 8 Unknown.

PHO1 phosphate exporter for xylem loading in pericycle/xylem parenchyma (Hamburger et al. 2002 Plant Cell, Arabidopsis); nodule vascular bundle by Molecular Cartography and E 69% vs <=5% (Cervantes-Perez 2024); Zhang 2025 nodule pericycle 243 / procambium 154 vs <=38 CPM. Liu 2023 vascular cluster 9 84% vs 9% (Supp. Data 3) agrees.

Hydroxyproline O-arabinosyltransferase; nodule vascular bundle by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024; E 53% vs <=8%) and an independent de novo nodule procambium marker in Zhang 2025 (14% vs 2%). Liu 2023 vascular cluster 9 53% vs 3% (Supp. Data 3) agrees.

PHO1 homolog; top vascular-bundle gene (E 87% vs <=2%, Cervantes-Perez 2024; no spatial check) and de novo nodule procambium and root pericycle marker in Zhang 2025. Third study: Liu 2023 vascular cluster 9 95% vs 13% (Supp. Data 3); raised medium->high.

SWEET sugar transporter; E 60% vs 0% (Cervantes-Perez 2024) and Zhang 2025 nodule procambium de novo (19% vs 4%). Phloem-parenchyma-like, not resolved. Third study: Liu 2023 vascular cluster 9 28% vs 1% (Supp. Data 3); raised medium->high.
Uncharacterized; nodule vascular bundle by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024; E 25% vs <=1%); weak in Zhang 2025.

Histidine kinase (MtHK1 ortholog per Table S8); vascular bundle by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024) E 37%, but also G 27%, F 13%; Zhang 2025 pericycle/procambium with infected-cell signal too.

Promoter-GUS stains the peripheral nodule vascular bundles (Liu et al. 2023 Nat Plants Fig. 1e); 45% of vascular cluster 9 vs <=2% elsewhere (10% IC); Stereo-seq vascular gene; Cervantes-Perez 2024 vascular bundle E 36% vs 0% elsewhere. Function not cell-type specific; two-study agreement raises to high.
Liu cluster 9 (31% vs 1%) and Stereo-seq vascular; Cervantes-Perez 2024 vascular bundle E 63%.
Liu cluster 9 (22% vs 0.5%), Stereo-seq vascular; Cervantes-Perez 2024 E 48%.
Annexin; Liu cluster 9 (35% vs 0.6%), Stereo-seq vascular; Cervantes-Perez 2024 E 28%.
LATERAL ROOT PRIMORDIUM 1-like; Liu cluster 9 (29% vs 1%); Cervantes-Perez 2024 E 34%.
Liu stele subcluster vb-5 'phloem pole pericycle' (22% vs 1%); label-transferred name, root-dominated subclusters; unvalidated.

Uncharacterized; Zhang 2025 nodule phloem de novo (25% vs 2%; 359 vs <=25 CPM) and a root phloem marker in Cervantes-Perez 2024. Conflict: that paper also used it by Molecular Cartography for a subset of infected cells (H 8%).
Trehalose-6-P synthase; Zhang 2025 nodule phloem de novo (26% vs 4%). Conflict: infected cells by Molecular Cartography in Cervantes-Perez 2024 (see Infected_Cell row).

Amino acid permease 3; Liu stele subcluster vb-6 'metaphloem & companion cell' (18% vs 0.02%). Subcluster named by Arabidopsis label transfer and dominated by root stele nuclei: root phloem, unvalidated in nodule.

Secondary-wall cellulose synthase; sclereid layer by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024; D 76% vs 0%). The same nuclei program is labeled Xylem by Zhang 2025 (nodule Xylem 589 vs <=13 CPM) and these genes are root xylem markers: secondary-wall cells, sclereid or xylem.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase; sclereid layer by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024; D 43%). Zhang 2025 nodule Xylem (29% vs 1%). Also xylem.
UDP-glucuronate decarboxylase (xylan); sclereid layer by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024; D 81% vs <=2%), also listed there as a vascular-bundle marker. Not in Zhang 2025 tables.
UDP-glucuronate decarboxylase; sclereid layer by Molecular Cartography (Cervantes-Perez 2024; D 81% vs <=4%); Zhang 2025 nodule Xylem 257 vs <=14 CPM. Also xylem.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase; D 86% vs <=1% (Cervantes-Perez 2024) and Zhang 2025 nodule Xylem de novo (68% vs 2%). Single-cell evidence only; also xylem.
Laccase (lignin polymerization); D 67% vs <=1% (Cervantes-Perez 2024) and Zhang 2025 nodule Xylem de novo (39% vs 1%). Single-cell evidence only; also xylem.
